role: PILOT_BILLING_MINIMUM_AUTHORITY_WRITER (bounded release successor for independent-certification finding B-1)

AS_OF.measurement_note: Every ledger fact asserted here was measured at BASE_SHA, where RELEASE_GATE_LEDGER_v1.0.0.json, STAGING_RELEASE_PRODUCTION_AUTHORITY_v1.0.0.json and STAGING_RELEASE_PRODUCTION_AUTHORITY_AMENDMENT_v1.0.1.json are byte-identical to CANDIDATE_PARENT_SHA. The per-stage figures below are DERIVED from the ledger's first_required_at_stage field by rule, not observed readiness, and carry no evidentiary weight about any environment.

NAMING_DERIVATION: The ledger carries append_only=true and the keys amends/supersedes. The repository convention for amending a frozen authority without editing it is a sibling <PARENT_PACKAGE_ID>_AMENDMENT_v1.0.1.json in the parent's own directory (precedents: docs/ops/release/STAGING_RELEASE_PRODUCTION_AUTHORITY_AMENDMENT_v1.0.1.json, docs/ops/commercial/COMMERCIAL_V1_MICRO_RATIFICATIONS_AMENDMENT_v1.0.1.json). The parent package_id is RELEASE_GATE_LEDGER, so the path is docs/ops/release/RELEASE_GATE_LEDGER_AMENDMENT_v1.0.1.json. Measured ABSENT at BASE_SHA and in every local and remote-tracking ref (git log --all over the path returned nothing). The ledger, not its companion authority, is amended because gate placement is NORMATIVE only in the ledger field first_required_at_stage (companion PRODUCTION_PATH step 8 normative_source: 'Where the two appear to disagree, the ledger governs'); the companion authority's per-stage lists restate derived content and are superseded here only in the respects listed under SUPERSEDED_CLAUSES. docs/ops/release/** is not a member of DEFAULT_PROTECTED_PATTERNS (scripts/ods-scope.ts) and is outside the sealed corpus of scripts/authority-seal-verify.ts, so no ODS grant is required.

TRIGGER.statement: PILOT_READY without Stripe was not formally reachable: PV3 (payment provider in test mode) and SEC7 (billing webhook integrity) were first required at FEATURE_COMPLETE_STAGING (ordinal 3) and, by NON_REGRESSION_RULE and the non-skippable stage rule, inherited by RELEASE_CANDIDATE and PILOT_READY; PV3 and SEC7 require the billing capability packages applied to the target and a replay test in Preview, which through billing OF-4 requires CB-5 before CAP-03, while PILOT-BILLING-01 defers CB-5 and forbids CAP-03 during the Pilot.

AMENDMENT_SEMANTICS.rule: APPEND-ONLY. docs/ops/release/RELEASE_GATE_LEDGER_v1.0.0.json, docs/ops/release/STAGING_RELEASE_PRODUCTION_AUTHORITY_v1.0.0.json and docs/ops/release/STAGING_RELEASE_PRODUCTION_AUTHORITY_AMENDMENT_v1.0.1.json are left BYTE-UNCHANGED and remain historical and canonical for everything they carry. This artifact changes ONE field of TWO gates and the companion restatements derived from that field, and nothing else.
AMENDMENT_SEMANTICS.how_to_read_the_four_together: Where this amendment is silent, the ledger, the companion authority and its v1.0.1 amendment control verbatim. Where this amendment names a clause under SUPERSEDED_CLAUSES, that clause is superseded ONLY in the respect stated and every other word of it continues to control. Where it names a clause under QUALIFIED_CLAUSES_NOT_SUPERSEDED, the clause controls in full and this amendment records only how it is read alongside the re-staging.
what_this_amendment_does: RE-STAGES PV3 and SEC7: first_required_at_stage FEATURE_COMPLETE_STAGING -> PRODUCTION_READY (GATE_RESTAGING RS-1, RS-2).

Adds the PAYMENT_PROVIDER_ENABLEMENT_PRECEDENCE rule (EPR), which makes PV3 and SEC7 required at the EARLIER of PRODUCTION_READY and the first enablement of the payment provider on any target, and which requires every stage declaration earlier than PRODUCTION_READY to carry a payment-provider-dark attestation.
Records the owner's scope-aware reading of HPO-G.6 and HPO-G.7 (RSC-5) and the disposition of HPO-G.5 and HPO-G.8.
Proves that the stage ladder, every other gate, and the cumulative gate sets of PRODUCTION_READY and GO_LIVE are unchanged.
what_this_amendment_is_not: NOT a waiver, deletion, retirement, satisfaction or PASS of PV3 or SEC7. Both keep id, name, category, enforcement, owner, current_state (PV3 ABSENT, SEC7 PARTIAL), pass_criteria, evidence_class, dependencies, retest_after and source_of_truth byte-identical.

NOT a new, removed, renamed, reordered or skippable stage. The seven canonical stages, their ordinals, their entry preconditions and the non-skippable rule are untouched. No stage named COMMERCIAL_CORE_USABLE exists or is created; that term remains a programme target of the commercial authorities.
NOT a change to any gate other than PV3 and SEC7, in any field.

NOT the ledger re-derivation required by STAGING_RELEASE_PRODUCTION_AUTHORITY_AMENDMENT_v1.0.1.json#LEDGER_REDERIVATION_REQUIREMENT (ENV-13). No corpus figure, readiness ratio or gate state is re-derived or pinned here.
NOT an authorization of any Stripe action, provider configuration, credential, hosted access, deployment or stage declaration.

NOT a claim that PILOT_READY is satisfied or near: gates in its derived set remain in their recorded states, including the open RELEASE_CANDIDATE tension between G1 and PV4 and the stop lines SSL-03, SSL-04, LSL-02..LSL-05.

CANONICAL_STAGE_LADDER_REFERENCE.unchanged: Recorded for machine checking only. This amendment adds, removes, renames and reorders nothing and alters no entry_preconditions: RELEASE_CANDIDATE still requires FEATURE_COMPLETE_STAGING declared at the same SHA; PILOT_READY still requires RELEASE_CANDIDATE declared and release gate PB-01 resolved or accepted in writing; PRODUCTION_READY still requires PILOT_READY declared with the pilot executed.

GATE_RESTAGING.reason: PV3 is the payment-provider configuration gate. Under PILOT-BILLING-01 the payment provider is deliberately OFF through PILOT_READY (RSC-1, RSC-5), so no Pilot-stage SHA has a payment provider to configure, and its criterion ('the capability packages are applied to the target, and a replay and duplicate-delivery test passes in Preview') is satisfiable only after CB-5, which the Pilot defers. Placed at the earliest EXISTING stage after PILOT_READY, and earlier on enablement by EPR.

SEC7 depends on PV3 and asserts integrity of a billing webhook that is disabled (CAP-03 off) throughout the Pilot; it cannot be required earlier than the gate it depends on without making the stage order unsatisfiable. Same placement and the same EPR precedence as PV3.

PLACEMENT_DERIVATION.rule_applied: Owner direction RSC-6: if a concrete first_required_at_stage is needed, take the earliest EXISTING post-PILOT_READY stage that preserves the full commercial/production invariant.

candidates.PRODUCTION_READY: ordinal 6, the first stage after PILOT_READY (ordinal 5). Production deployment is authorized there (HPO-G.8). Placing PV3 and SEC7 here keeps the cumulative gate set of PRODUCTION_READY IDENTICAL to the pre-amendment set, so no production authorization can be issued without them.
candidates.GO_LIVE: REJECTED. It would let PRODUCTION_READY authorize production deployment without payment-provider proof, which changes the PRODUCTION_READY gate set and weakens HPO-G.8.

PLACEMENT_DERIVATION.dependency_consistency: PV3 depends on S5 (STAGING_ALIGNED, ordinal 2 <= 6). SEC7 depends on PV3 (both ordinal 6). No gate first required at ordinal <= 5 depends on PV3 or SEC7: the only dependent of PV3 is SEC7, and SEC7 has no dependent (measured over every GATES[].dependencies). The ledger self_check property no_gate_depends_on_a_gate_first_required_at_a_later_stage therefore still holds.

PAYMENT_PROVIDER_ENABLEMENT_PRECEDENCE.owner_source: RSC-5 ('Stripe-specific provider gates are deferred WHEN Stripe is deliberately OFF'): the deferral is predicated on the provider being off, so it cannot survive the provider being switched on.
PAYMENT_PROVIDER_ENABLEMENT_PRECEDENCE.rule: PV3 and SEC7 are required at the EARLIER of (a) PRODUCTION_READY and (b) the first ENABLEMENT of the payment provider on any target. Neither gate may be regressed after it has been required.
enablement_means_any_of: a payment-provider credential NAME present in the environment scope of a target (names only; SSL-08)
the billing webhook capability CAP-03 switched on for a target, including app/api/webhooks/stripe/route.ts WEBHOOK_DATABASE_IDENTITY_AVAILABLE true at the deployed SHA
any path that creates a payment-provider customer, checkout session or subscription reachable at the deployed SHA
any Stripe-dependent node of the commercial authorities (CB-3, CB-4, CB-5, CB-6, CB-9, CE-6) applied to a target
PAYMENT_PROVIDER_ENABLEMENT_PRECEDENCE.declaration_requirement: Every declaration of FEATURE_COMPLETE_STAGING, RELEASE_CANDIDATE or PILOT_READY cites, alongside its gate evidence, a PAYMENT_PROVIDER_DARK attestation bound to the declared SHA and target: no member of enablement_means_any_of holds. A declaration below PRODUCTION_READY that cannot attest the provider dark MUST instead cite PASS evidence for PV3 and SEC7; with neither, it is not a declaration (declaration_rule of the companion authority). This is an additional requirement, never a substitute for any gate.
PAYMENT_PROVIDER_ENABLEMENT_PRECEDENCE.why_not_a_gate: No gate id is allocated. The attestation is a declaration-content condition attached to an existing rule, so the ledger's closed gate list and its 78-gate count are unchanged.
PAYMENT_PROVIDER_ENABLEMENT_PRECEDENCE.consequence_for_the_pilot: Under ACTIVE_WITHOUT_STRIPE the provider is dark by construction of the consuming authority (PBR-9, PB-N-22; CAP-03 FORBIDDEN IN PILOT), so clause (b) never fires before PRODUCTION_READY and the Pilot path requires neither PV3 nor SEC7.
PAYMENT_PROVIDER_ENABLEMENT_PRECEDENCE.consequence_for_the_full_commercial_rout: Full Stripe automation (COMMERCIAL_CORE_USABLE of the commercial authorities) enables the provider, so PV3 and SEC7 must PASS before that enablement on any target, and in every case before PRODUCTION_READY is declared at any SHA. Billing OF-4 (CAP-03 MUST NOT be enabled before CB-5) is untouched and composes with EPR.

HPO_G_DISPOSITION.rule: HPO-G text is NOT amended and NOT reopened. The owner's own reading of HPO-G.6 and HPO-G.7 (RSC-5, recorded in the binding owner ratification) is materialized here.
HPO_G_DISPOSITION.HPO-G.5: UNCHANGED. STAGING_ALIGNED still requires parity with provider capabilities dark (S7, S10). The payment provider stays dark for longer, which is compatible with and stricter than G.5.
HPO_G_DISPOSITION.HPO-G.6: SCOPE-AWARE. 'Then browser/provider gates' is read as: every browser journey gate (M9, J1, J2, J3, J4, G13) and every provider gate APPLICABLE TO THE RELEASE CONFIGURATION (PV1, PV2, PV5, PV6; PV4 stays at RELEASE_CANDIDATE as before) is required at FEATURE_COMPLETE_STAGING, before RELEASE_CANDIDATE. The payment-provider gates PV3 and SEC7 are applicable only to a configuration in which the payment provider is enabled; with the provider deliberately OFF they are deferred to PRODUCTION_READY, and EPR pulls them forward the moment the provider is enabled.
HPO_G_DISPOSITION.HPO-G.7: UNCHANGED. RELEASE_CANDIDATE may not be entered before FEATURE_COMPLETE_STAGING is declared at the same SHA; no RELEASE_CANDIDATE gate is added, removed or moved.
HPO_G_DISPOSITION.HPO-G.8: UNCHANGED AND CARRIED. Production still requires recovery evidence, observability, security and legal signoff and normal lineage; the PRODUCTION_READY new-gate list gains PV3 and SEC7, and its cumulative set is unchanged.

NON_REGRESSION_RULE_DISPOSITION: UNCHANGED AND APPLIED. Each gate is still listed once, at its earliest required stage, and inherited by every later stage. After this amendment PV3 and SEC7 are listed at PRODUCTION_READY and inherited by GO_LIVE; per-stage sets remain DERIVED from first_required_at_stage (read through GATE_RESTAGING) and are never restated.

DERIVED_STAGE_SETS.method: cumulative set of stage N = every GATES[].id whose first_required_at_stage (after GATE_RESTAGING) has ordinal <= N; ledger gate count 78.

PILOT_READY_REACHABILITY.claim: FORMALLY REACHABLE WITHOUT STRIPE under ACTIVE_WITHOUT_STRIPE: the ladder DEVELOPMENT_COMPLETE -> STAGING_ALIGNED -> FEATURE_COMPLETE_STAGING -> RELEASE_CANDIDATE -> PILOT_READY contains no gate that requires the payment provider, CB-5 or CAP-03.
PILOT_READY_REACHABILITY.basis: The derived PILOT_READY set (60 gates) excludes exactly PV3 and SEC7. A whole-ledger search of every gate's name, pass_criteria and source_of_truth for stripe, payment, billing and webhook matches only PV3 and SEC7 (the word 'checkout' additionally occurs in M1 and M8, where it is the git/CI checkout step, not a payment checkout). The LC0 baseline gates commercial_activation on legal instruments (HTF-11), not on payment (docs/ops/compliance/LC0_CANONICAL_REGULATORY_DATA_GOVERNANCE_BASELINE_v1.0.0.json), and LC0-PILOT's criterion is unchanged.
PILOT_READY_REACHABILITY.what_reachable_does_not_mean: Reachable is a structural property: no gate on the path is unsatisfiable BECAUSE the provider is off. Every other gate on the path must still be satisfied with evidence at the declared SHA; none is satisfied, accepted or narrowed here.

SUPERSEDED_CLAUSES.rule: Each entry names one clause, quotes it verbatim, and states the SINGLE respect in which it no longer controls.
